plan.title: Rewire the consumer task surface to deft verbs with zero Python entrypoints (Phase 2)

narratives.Description: The consumer .deft/core/Taskfile.yml and tasks/*.yml files still invoke python3, uv run, and scripts/*.py directly across roughly two dozen task files. This story rewires every consumer-path task to dispatch through deft verbs and clearly separates or removes maintainer-only Python tasks, so the consumer deposit has no Python entrypoints. It depends on the Phase 1 conversions because each rewired task needs its native handler to already exist.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Audit Taskfile.yml and tasks/*.yml for python3, uv run, and scripts/*.py entrypoints on the consumer path and replace each with the corresponding deft verb now available from Phase 1.
- Move any genuinely maintainer-only Python tasks behind the #1813 contributor path or remove them, then run task verify:no-task-runtime to confirm the consumer surface is Python-free.
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer running task verbs, I want the task surface to call deft verbs only, so that no consumer task shells into Python.
